evals.expected_output: Fetches SKILL.md and evals/ at a pinned sha, finds no licence and so rewrites from scratch, maps ADRs to docs/ADRs/, practices to AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md, tasks to docs/WFIPs/WFIP-NNNN.tasks.md and resume to claude --continue/--resume, states the from-scratch choice before writing, and produces .claude/skills/obsidian-vault/ with a vault path from an env var and adapted evals.

assertions.description: The credit line names a commit sha, not just a branch
Reports the repo has no licence and chooses rewrite, copying no upstream sentence verbatim
Shows an upstream-concept -> home-here table before writing
No second decisions directory is created; decisions route to docs/ADRs/ and designs to a WFIP
Resume points to claude --continue/--resume before any vault handoff
~/edvmorango does not appear in the ported skill
evals/evals.json exists with cases rewritten for ww3-gpu
The front matter carries no model: key

evals.prompt: port this: https://github.com/blader/humanizer — we want it in ww3-gpu
evals.expected_output: Detects an MIT licence, finds no existing home for the concept, and vendors it verbatim with LICENSE beside it, a skills.lock entry and an audience patch, adding an AGENTS.md 'Skills and agents' row with provenance; or reports that .claude/skills/humanizer already exists and is pinned in skills.lock, and stops.

assertions.description: Notices .claude/skills/humanizer is already vendored and does not create a duplicate
States the upstream licence it found

evals.prompt: copy the 'git commit helper' skill from https://github.com/example/dotfiles/tree/main/skills/commit — it writes commit messages with a Generated-by footer
evals.expected_output: Maps the concept to AGENTS.md's commit rule (Tested: and Cost: trailers, the harness's own attribution lines, no model name in the repository), finds the footer conflicts with it, and either drops that part or reports that no skill is the right port.

assertions.description: Does not keep a Generated-by footer; cites AGENTS.md's Tested:/Cost: trailer rule
Does not write a SKILL.md before stating vendor/adapt/rewrite/none
